extraction_notes: Only SI Figure S6 contains in-scope catalytic ammonia synthesis performance data. Values are approximate readings from the plot. The SI does not state feed H2/N2 ratio, space velocity, catalyst mass, or total flow for Figure S6. SI Figure S1 was not extracted because it reports pure-H2 hydrogenation/nitrogen-transfer of a post-N2-TG sample and gives total NH3 amount rather than an ammonia synthesis rate, outlet NH3 concentration, or TOF. Characterisation figures/tables were omitted.
